JOYSTAR Secret 700C Electric Commuter Bike - 350W
⚡ BUY AN E-BIKE & ENJOY SPECIAL HELMET PRICING! *Important: You must add the helmet to your cart for the discount to apply automatically.

Experience the perfect blend of efficiency and hidden power with the Hiland Secret Electric Commuter Bike. Designed for the modern urban explorer, this e-bike offers a sleek, traditional look with an integrated motor and battery system that makes every commute effortless.

Sleek, powerful, and discreet: The Hiland Secret Electric Commuter Bike.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered for the city, the Hiland Secret delivers a smooth, stabilized ride with a high-torque motor and safety-certified power system."
Balanced Power & Traction
The Joystar Secret features a 350W balanced rear-hub motor that provides superior weight distribution and improved traction on uneven city streets. Coupled with a UL2849-certified battery, you can enjoy a reliable range of up to 40 miles while knowing your ride meets the highest electrical safety standards.

Advanced suspension and wide 700x38C tires for ultimate urban comfort.

Smart Urban Design

UL-Certified Battery: Built-in, removable battery with anti-theft protection and a 40-mile range.

Front Suspension: High-performance fork absorbs road vibrations for a responsive riding experience.

High-Grip Tires: 700 x 38C tires provide extra stability and confidence on both asphalt and light trails.

Step-Through Frame: Upgraded aluminum frame for easy mounting and dismounting in professional or casual attire.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Get on the road faster. The Hiland Secret arrives 85% pre-assembled. We provide the tools and clear instructions needed to finish the job in just a few simple steps.
